recommendations: Open lane 1, 'Real Leonida': one real Florida place or phenomenon per reel (Vice City and Miami's Art Deco and Ocean Drive, the Everglades behind Grassrivers, the Keys, the 'Florida Man' culture the trailers riff on). It uses the same second-person, number-shock structure but a different subject from Unseen. AI visuals are legitimate here because they illustrate real places, not fake gameplay. After launch, add side-by-sides with the account's own gameplay. Precedents: GTA V vs LA, Black Myth: Wukong's real Shanxi sites.

Open lane 2, launch-day 'fan map vs official map': prepare the template now, crediting State of Leonida (about 1,600 markers) and Dark Space and asking permission for their visuals. Publish within hours of any official Leonida map (reportedly a free download on Nov 19, unverified). Follow with a short series, 'what the trailers promised vs what shipped'.

Open lane 3, 'GTA 6 by the money': a second-person economics series ('You just paid for this. Here is where it goes'). Use only confirmed Take-Two and Rockstar numbers plus clearly labeled analyst estimates (for example Piper Sandler's 48M launch units). News pages ignore this angle, and it reaches Instagram's finance-curious audience.

Open lane 4, fact-checks of viral GTA 6 claims (fake leaks, AI-made fake gameplay, made-up stat tallies) with sources shown on screen. After launch, test viral claims in the account's own playthrough. Trust is scarce while AI fakes are everywhere. Use the creator's own sourcing format rather than Unseen's 'our arithmetic / on the record / measured / estimate' blocks.

Open lane 5 (after launch), a satire and parody decoder: GTA's fake brands, radio shows, ads and in-game news parody real things, and players search for what each one targets. The voiceover decodes it over the account's own gameplay, so it does not depend on AI depicting the game. This is the most original fit for the RDR2- and GTA V-style 'details' wave that peaks in the month after launch.

Open lane 6, the people around GTA 6: short narrated profiles of the soundtrack artists (launch-trailer song credits), the voice cast once credited, the fan mappers, and viral fans. Handle tributes (for example Jerry Fort) with care and avoid exploiting grief. News pages only do headlines here.

Open lane 7, versions in other languages: French pages (@gta6alerte about 102K on TikTok, @gta6france_ about 32K on Instagram) show demand outside English. Run Spanish or Portuguese mirror accounts using the cloned voice's multilingual output, at low extra cost. The size of those markets is not verified.

Avoid: countdown-only posts (TikTok already has topic pages for single day numbers), leak reposts (Rockstar takes them down), raw trailer reuploads (against Rockstar's guidance; platforms penalize unoriginal content), 'waiting for GTA 6' memes (the premise dies Nov 19), AI 'gameplay' that viewers could mistake for real footage, and reposting streamer clips (clippers will flood launch week).

Timing: Nov 12 to 18, publish lanes 1, 3 and 4 plus the map template. Nov 19, the map comparison and 'promised vs shipped'. Nov 19 to about Dec 19 (historically the peak month for tips, secrets and details), lanes 1 and 5 with the account's own gameplay. If and when GTA 6's online mode launches, plan a second wave, as GTA Online did two weeks after GTA V and Red Dead Online about a month after RDR2.

Originality versus the reference: use a different series frame (not 'Day N until launch'), a different hook device (not 'Thank you for...'), a different sign-off and a different visual look. Design the series to continue after launch, because Unseen's countdown frame ends after about 11 episodes on Nov 19 while the biggest audience arrives after launch.

research.summary: GTA VI launches Thursday 19 Nov 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It is also on Xbox Cloud Gaming, which includes Xbox One. Rockstar Support says it unlocks at midnight local time in every region: 00:00 GMT in the UK, 00:00 IST in India (18:30 UTC on Wednesday) and 00:00 ET in New York. The US West Coast time is still open: the US store listing points to 9 PM PT Wednesday, while Rockstar's wording points to 12 AM PT Thursday. Check it again on 17 Nov. Preload opened on 10 Nov (PS5 at midnight local time, Xbox at 00:00 GMT) and is up to 212 GB. Code-in-box retail copies with no disc go on sale today, 12 Nov, and two independent shops are refusing to stock them. This week's best verified numbers come from the preload: Virgin Media O2 hit its all-time traffic record (+51.6% on the week before, within an hour of preload opening), YouFibre had congestion around Yorkshire, and 1&1 in Germany saw about 10x its normal overnight console traffic. I found no source for the reference reel's claim that Danish traffic ran 50% above normal. Sony and Microsoft both confirmed GTA VI is the most pre-ordered game in their store histories, without giving counts. Sensor Tower estimates about 10.31M digital pre-orders worth about $1B by 11 Nov. On 9 Nov Take-Two said Rockstar has finished the game and that pre-orders are 'tracking far in excess of our initial expectations'. It reported Q2 bookings down 18% to $1.60B, kept its full-year guide at $8.0-8.2B and guided Q3 to $3.35-3.5B. Zelnick said 'the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough', which suggests a sales announcement after launch is the next big news beat. Reviews are reported, not confirmed, to go live on 18 Nov at an unknown time, and none were out as of 12 Nov. Coming dates: 18 Nov, reviews and the first unlock in New Zealand (11:00 UTC). 19 Nov, launch, GTA VI: The Album (34 original tracks) and the $399.99 collector box that does not include the game. 21 Nov, GTA VI: The Festival in Miami (Travis Scott, Cardi B, Justice; presented by PlayStation). 26 Nov, US Thanksgiving and one week since launch. No GTA 6 Online and no PC version have been announced. The Cyberleek leaks, preload datamines and 'unplayable for millions' headlines are all unverified and risky for a new account. Caveat: this session could not open rockstargames.com, support.rockstargames.com or sec.gov because of its network settings, and the shared web-search budget ran out. Several primary statements were therefore read from search-engine extracts, not the pages themselves.

findings.claim: 2025-11 (context): Rockstar set Grand Theft Auto VI for Thursday 19 Nov 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, moving it from May 2026. The date has held through 12 Nov 2026.

findings.claim: 12 Oct 2026 (ongoing risk): an anonymous leaker called 'Cyberleek' posted about 24 minutes of alleged footage, including nude clips of Jason and Lucia. The leaker threatened to release a full playable build if their memecoin reaches a $30M market cap, and demanded physical discs and an apology from Take-Two.
findings.note: No confirmation from Rockstar or Take-Two found. Never show or link the leaked footage.

findings.note: No newer trailer found for 1-12 Nov. Early YouTube view counts conflict between outlets (one says about 13.8M views and 1.1M likes in about 8 hours; ghacks article dated 16 Oct). No current total verified.

The time of day is unconfirmed: one report says about 6-7 AM ET (12:01-1:01 PM CET), another says 12:01 AM ET on 19 Nov for some outlets.
findings.note: Rockstar and Take-Two have not confirmed the codes or the embargo. No published reviews found as of 12 Nov.

findings.claim: 3 Nov 2026: Rockstar Support wording: 'Grand Theft Auto VI will release midnight local time on November 19, 2026, in all regions for both PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series X|S.'
findings.note: The quote and the 3 Nov update date come from search extracts and timesaver.gg, because support.rockstargames.com is blocked for direct fetch here. The quote may be on a related support article rather than this one.

findings.claim: UK unlock: 00:00 GMT Thursday 19 Nov, per the UK PS Store listing. This matches Rockstar's midnight-local-time rule.

India unlock: 12:00 AM IST Thursday 19 Nov (18:30 UTC / 1:30 PM ET on Wednesday 18 Nov), per the PS Store India and Xbox India listings. India preload opened at 12:00 AM IST (PS5) and 5:30 AM IST (Xbox) on 10 Nov.
findings.note: The UTC and ET conversions are my own.

findings.claim: US unlock: 12:00 AM ET Thursday 19 Nov (05:00 UTC) on the East Coast. The West Coast is unresolved. The US PS Store listing reportedly unlocks at 05:00 UTC, which is 9 PM PT / 10 PM MT / 11 PM CT on Wednesday 18 Nov; Forbes calls the 9 PM PT time unofficial. A literal reading of Rockstar's rule gives 12:00 AM PT on Thursday 19 Nov.
findings.note: No clarification from Rockstar found through 12 Nov. One source says the account's store region decides the unlock, not the player's physical location.

findings.claim: Calculated unlock order, assuming every storefront unlocks at local midnight on 19 Nov: New Zealand at 11:00 UTC Wednesday 18 Nov (3 AM PT / 6 AM ET / 4:30 PM IST), then Sydney 13:00 UTC, Tokyo 15:00 UTC, India 18:30 UTC, Central Europe 23:00 UTC, UK 00:00 UTC Thursday, New York 05:00 UTC, and Los Angeles at 05:00 or 08:00 UTC. India plays 5.5 hours before London and 10.5 hours before New York.
findings.note: My own arithmetic from Rockstar's rule. US daylight saving ended 1 Nov 2026, and New Zealand and eastern Australia are on daylight time. The Well Played headline is 'Australians will play GTA 6 first'.

findings.claim: 9 Nov 2026: Take-Two fiscal Q2 2027 results. Total net bookings were $1.60B, down 18% from $1.96B. Recurrent consumer spending fell 9% and made up 81% of net bookings.
findings.note: The 8-K text was read from a search extract because sec.gov is blocked for direct fetch here. Inven Global and BigGo report that bookings came in slightly under the $1.62-1.67B guide and blame NBA 2K27 softness.

findings.claim: 9 Nov 2026 outlook: the FY2027 net bookings guide was held at $8.0-8.2B, not raised. Fiscal Q3 (Oct-Dec) net bookings were guided to $3.35-3.5B, against $1.76B a year earlier (about 2x), on the strength of the GTA VI launch. Zelnick declined to guide FY2028.

9 Nov 2026 earnings call, Zelnick: Rockstar has finished developing GTA VI (it has gone gold). Pre-orders are 'tracking far in excess of our initial expectations', and executives also called them 'unprecedented' and 'extraordinary'. On numbers: 'the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough'. On the reported $1.5B budget: 'We haven't spoken about budgets at all'. He also said GTA VI is pushing people to buy consoles, that Rockstar will keep supporting GTA Online, and that Take-Two avoids claiming success before it happens and will update investors after launch.
findings.note: Also covered by the GamesBeat takeaways (https://gamesbeat.com/all-the-takeaways-on-gta-from-the-take-two-earnings-call-strauss-zelnick/) and the Motley Fool transcript (https://www.fool.com/earnings/call-transcripts/2026/11/10/take-two-ttwo-q2-2027-earnings-call-transcript/). A Yahoo Finance headline quotes the CEO calling GTA VI the 'most-anticipated entertainment property of all time'; the date of that quote is not verified.

findings.claim: Market reaction: TTWO rose about 4% after hours on 9 Nov (GamesBeat). Quantisnow reports it closed up 8.09% at $224.54 on a down day for the market. Jefferies analyst Randal Konik said 'the quality of the quarter was weaker than it looks.'
findings.note: Coverage is unclear about which session the +8% close was; it was probably 10 Nov, since Motley Fool ran 'Why Take-Two Stock's Got Game Today' that day. The Konik quote comes from the Yahoo Finance live blog.

findings.claim: Analyst math: GamesBeat says the Q3 guide implies roughly $1.45-1.6B of GTA VI net bookings in the launch quarter. Motley Fool argues the forecast assumes little GTA VI revenue after the launch month and may be too low.
findings.note: Do not compare this directly with Sensor Tower's ~$1B figure. Take-Two's net bookings and store revenue estimates are not measured the same way.

findings.claim: Night of 9-10 Nov: German ISP 1&1 saw about 10x its normal overnight traffic to PlayStation Network and Xbox, per a spokesperson quoted by t-online. This counts console-platform traffic only, not the whole network.

10 Nov 2026: digital preload opened for digital pre-orders. PS5 started at midnight local time on Tuesday 10 Nov. Xbox Series X|S started worldwide at 12:00 AM GMT on 10 Nov (7 PM ET / 4 PM PT on Monday 9 Nov). The download is up to 212 GB depending on the device, and preloading does not allow early play.
findings.note: Read from a search extract. The June pre-order announcement reportedly gave 12 Nov as the preload date, and many guides still say 12 Nov. Notebookcheck gives a noon Xbox start, which conflicts with Rockstar. The time-zone conversions are my own.

Reference reel fact check: searches in English, Danish and German found no source for the line 'In Denmark, the night preload opened, internet traffic ran fifty percent above a normal night'. The closest documented figure is Virgin Media O2's +51.6% on the previous week, in the UK.

recommendations: TODAY, 12 Nov (code-in-box day), post within 24 hours. Hook: 'You can buy GTA 6 in a shop today. Open the box: there is no game inside.' Order: Rockstar's 'A disc will not be included in the box' (confirmed), then 212 GB (confirmed), then two independent shops refusing to stock it (reported). Midpoint rehook: 'so why sell a box at all?' Payoff: it lets people preload a week before launch (the timing is confirmed). Rockstar has given no reason for leaving out the disc, so do not make one up. Optional 'our maths' segment: 212 GB against a 100 GB PS5 disc would need 3 discs; check the disc capacity first. The reference creator used a one-line no-disc beat, so make the retailer revolt and the disc maths the original angle.

13 Nov: 'The night GTA 6 hit the internet' (ISP reel). Lead with Virgin Media O2: traffic up 51.6% on the previous week within an hour of preload, and a new all-time peak 3.8% above the old one (reported). Then YouFibre's congestion in Yorkshire (reported) and 1&1 Germany at about 10x its normal overnight console traffic (reported). 'Our maths' segment, labelled as an estimate on screen: one 212 GB download takes about 28 minutes at 1 Gbps, 4.7 hours at 100 Mbps and 18.8 hours at 25 Mbps; about 10.3M estimated pre-orders times 212 GB is up to about 2.2 exabytes. Do not reuse the reference reel's Denmark '+50%' line, because no source for it was found.

14 Nov: '$1 billion before anyone pressed start.' Sony and Microsoft both confirmed their store pre-order records without counts (confirmed). Sensor Tower estimates about 10.31M digital pre-orders worth about $1B by 11 Nov, with about 3 in 4 on PS5; say 'analysts estimate' on screen. The previous benchmark is Cyberpunk 2077 at about 8M (reported). Close on Zelnick's 'the numbers will speak for themselves soon enough' to set up a sales reel after launch.

15 Nov: Take-Two reel, hook 'Wall Street is betting a whole quarter on one Thursday'. Q2 bookings fell 18% to $1.60B (confirmed), yet the stock rose about 4% after hours and reportedly closed 8% higher, because Zelnick said Rockstar has finished the game and pre-orders are 'far in excess of our initial expectations'. Q3 is guided at $3.35-3.5B, roughly double last year (reported). On the rumoured $1.5B budget he said 'We haven't spoken about budgets at all'. Show the source for each finance number on screen and give no investment advice.

Order: New Zealand at 11:00 UTC Wednesday 18 Nov, then Australia, Japan, India at 12:00 AM IST (18:30 UTC, 1:30 PM ET Wednesday), Europe, the UK at 00:00 GMT Thursday, New York at 00:00 ET (05:00 UTC), and the US West Coast at 9 PM PT Wednesday or 12 AM PT Thursday (unresolved). India hook: 'India gets GTA 6 10.5 hours before New York.' Check the PS Store and Xbox listings again on 17 Nov, and pin a correction comment if Rockstar clarifies the Pacific time.

Include the Metacritic/OpenCritic average, the number of reviews, and 2-3 short, credited, spoiler-free quotes. Build the edit with placeholder slots on 17 Nov. If the embargo moves, post a 'why the reviews aren't out yet' reel the same day instead.

Cover what is missing at launch: no GTA 6 Online and no PC version. Xbox One owners can stream it through Xbox Cloud Gaming (confirmed); check the subscription terms on the day. Keep titles and thumbnails free of spoilers.

19 Nov: album reel, '34 songs written for a state that doesn't exist'. GTA VI: The Album is out the same day (confirmed), with 34 original tracks on Atlantic (reported). The shock line is Keith Richards, Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, Cardi B and Rauw Alejandro on one record. Use only Instagram or TikTok library audio. Justice's score on 11 Dec is the next beat.

GTA VI: The Festival at Mana Wynwood (confirmed), presented by PlayStation, with Travis Scott, Cardi B, Metro Boomin and Justice (lineup reported) and tickets by lottery only. Use AI visuals or your own footage, and do not use Rockstar or PlayStation logos as account branding.

Prepare the GTA V comparison now: the widely cited figures are $800M on day one and $1B in three days in Sept 2013; check them against Take-Two's 2013 press releases before use. 26 Nov is US Thanksgiving and one week since launch, a natural recap reel.

Quick fill-in reels for 13-18 Nov (fast to make, high search intent): 'Preload opened on 10 Nov, not 12 Nov' (confirmed). 'Preloading doesn't let you play early' (confirmed). 'Your Ultimate extras aren't missing, they unlock in the game' (guide claim, unverified; check first). 'An Xbox in Shutdown mode won't preload' (guide claim, unverified).

Price reel, which draws comments any day: $79.99/$99.99 in the US, £69.99/£89.99 in the UK and ₹5,999/₹7,499 in India (reported store prices), a $20 Ultimate upgrade, and a $399.99 collector box with no game. 'Our maths' option: GTA V's $59.99 in 2013, adjusted for inflation; calculate it with the BLS CPI calculator before saying it.

Rumour handling, as a format of this account's own: a 'real vs rumour' reel with confidence labels on screen. It can cover the datamine claims (223 GB in 53 files, 22 GiB of audio, PS5 firmware 14.22, the missing 704 KB Australia/NZ chunk, FSR 4.1, PS5 Pro modes) and the 'unplayable for millions' headlines. research.summary: Launch week (Nov 12 to 19) will almost certainly pay $0 from platforms, because no program can be cleared by a new account in 7 days. The gates are: TikTok Creator Rewards needs 10K followers and 100K views in 30 days; Instagram Gifts needs 500 followers and a payout account; YouTube fan funding needs 500 subscribers and 3M Shorts views in 90 days; YouTube ad revenue needs 1,000 subscribers and 10M Shorts views in 90 days. Instagram Gifts can switch on within weeks but pays only $0.01 per star. The first meaningful platform payout is TikTok Creator Rewards, which is open to residents of the US, UK, DE, FR, JP, KR, MX and BR, needs a personal (not business) account, and pays only on original videos of 1 minute or longer. The 81-second reference format qualifies, and this is realistic in month 1 only if a video breaks out. YouTube Shorts ad revenue is effectively out of reach in this window: from Feb 1, 2027 new partners need 20M Shorts views in 90 days, and every partner needs 10M qualified Shorts views per trailing 90 days to be paid for Shorts. Use YouTube for reach plus the unchanged 500-subscriber fan-funding tier. Facebook Content Monetization is still invite-only. The better Facebook route is Creator Fast Track (US/CA/UK/AU): $100 to $450 per month for 3 months at 20K to 99,999 followers on IG, TikTok or YouTube, and $1,000 at 100K+. It requires that you have NOT posted a Facebook reel in the prior 6 months, so do not auto-share reels to Facebook yet. Amazon pays only 1% on physical games and consoles, 2% on digital games and 3% on headphones, so a $70 GTA 6 copy earns about $0.70. Affiliate links only matter around Black Friday (Nov 27) and Cyber Monday (Nov 30) and should push accessories. Meta and TikTok pay only for original content: Meta pays for content you created or meaningfully enhanced and does not pay for static-image videos, and TikTok excludes Duets and Stitches. Edits built mostly from trailers put payouts at risk. Sponsorships are likely the largest month 2 to 3 income for an account that breaks out, but I could not verify current gaming rate benchmarks this session. Compliance gate: creator income is self-employment income, with 15.3% SE tax once net earnings reach $400 and 1099 thresholds reportedly now $2,000 (NEC) and $20,000 (1099-K). If the creator is in F-1 status, USCIS limits work to authorized categories, and unauthorized employment is a failure to maintain status (8 CFR 214.1(e)). So turn on no monetization until a DSO or immigration attorney confirms authorization. Research caveat: direct page fetches were blocked and the shared search budget ran out mid-stream, so the tax, immigration, FTC and Amazon-rules items come from prior knowledge and are labeled unverified.

findings.claim: GTA 6 is scheduled for Thursday, November 19, 2026 on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Rockstar moved it there from May 26, 2026 and announced the change on its official X account. A PC date is not confirmed. The launch window overlaps Black Friday (Nov 27) and Cyber Monday (Nov 30, 2026), the peak retail days for console and accessory affiliate links.
findings.note: Corroborated by GamesRadar (https://www.gamesradar.com/games/grand-theft-auto/gta-6-delayed-6-more-months-as-rockstar-commits-to-november-2026-and-says-sorry) and by Fox10 on 2026-10-16 (https://www.fox10tv.com/2026/10/16/gta-6-locks-nov-19-release-date-after-delays/?outputType=amp). Rockstar's own page was not fetched. One search summary said digital preload opens Nov 12, without a clear source (unverified). The Black Friday and Cyber Monday dates are calendar math: Thanksgiving is Nov 26, 2026.

findings.claim: TikTok Creator Rewards Program (US terms) requirements: age 18+; a personal account in good standing (business, government and political accounts are excluded); at least 10,000 followers and 100,000 video views in the last 30 days. Only original videos at least 1 minute long can earn. Duets and Stitches do not count, and a video must pass 1,000 qualified views. A payment account and tax onboarding are required.
findings.note: US terms: https://www.tiktok.com/legal/page/global/creator-rewards-program-us/en . The Japan/Korea terms require 50,000 followers. Read through search-result extracts of the official pages, not a direct fetch. The 81 s reference reel would qualify; 20 to 50 s hype clips earn nothing from this program.

findings.claim: Creator Rewards eligibility depends on country of residence. TikTok's Creator Academy lists the US, UK, Germany, Japan, South Korea, France, Mexico and Brazil.
findings.note: Another TikTok page adds Italy and Turkey and drops Mexico. Third-party lists are longer and look unreliable. Check the in-app Creator Rewards page.

findings.claim: Current YouTube Partner Program entry for ad revenue: 1,000 subscribers plus either 4,000 valid public watch hours in the last 12 months or 10 million valid public Shorts views in the last 90 days.
findings.note: From a search-result extract. support.google.com was blocked for direct fetch in this session.

findings.claim: Expanded YPP covers fan funding only (channel memberships, Super Chat, Super Stickers, Super Thanks). It requires 500 subscribers, 3 valid public uploads in the last 90 days, and either 3,000 watch hours in 12 months or 3 million Shorts views in 90 days. YouTube says the 2027 changes do not alter the eligibility for fan funding, YouTube Creator Partnerships (brand deals) or YouTube Shopping.
findings.note: The statement that these thresholds are unchanged is per https://blog.youtube/news-and-events/youtube-partner-program-updates-2027-new-opportunities-earn/ . The exact US threshold for the Shopping affiliate program was not verified.

findings.claim: YouTube has announced these changes for Feb 1, 2027. New YPP applicants need 1,000 subscribers plus either 8,000 watch hours in 365 days or 20 million qualified Shorts views in 90 days. Every partner must hold 10 million qualified Shorts views over the trailing 90 days to earn from the Shorts Creator Pool in a given month; missing that does not remove YPP status or long-form earnings. A channel stays active with any one of: 1,000 watch hours in 365 days, 1 million Shorts views in 90 days, or 2 long-form or 5 Shorts uploads per 90 days. Existing partners keep their status but must accept the new terms by Jan 31, 2027.
findings.note: Also https://support.google.com/youtube/answer/12843009 . This is announced policy and could still change. Implication: a channel accepted under the 10M bar before Feb 1 avoids the 20M entry bar, but it still needs about 3.3M qualified Shorts views per month afterwards to be paid for Shorts.

findings.claim: Shorts ad revenue: YouTube pools Shorts ad revenue and splits it by each channel's share of eligible Shorts views. Creators keep 45% of their allocation. Ads targeted at 5 or fewer channels pay those channels a direct 45% share on top.
findings.note: The targeted-ads detail comes from a search extract of YouTube's 2027 update post. No per-view Shorts RPM was verified this session.

findings.claim: Instagram Gifts on Reels requirements: a professional account; age 18+; at least 500 followers; an eligible country; acceptance of the Gifts Creator Terms; a payout account; and compliance with the Partner and Content Monetization Policies. Collab posts and accounts focused on children cannot earn Gifts. Instagram pays $0.01 per star received, monthly.
findings.note: Meta's November 2023 announcement said 5,000 followers; the current help page says 500, so check the Professional Dashboard. The help page refers to availability for eligible US creators. Scale check: 10,000 stars = $100.

findings.claim: Instagram's Content Monetization Policies make 'static videos' (one static image with little or no motion) ineligible. Payouts go only to business or creator accounts that have a payout account and meet each tool's minimum earnings threshold.
findings.note: Payouts page: https://help.instagram.com/217939383051653 . Implication: AI stills need real motion (camera moves or video generation), not a held still under narration.

findings.claim: Instagram has no open bonus program a new account can join. Bonuses are limited-time and invite-only, and the Reels Play bonus closed to new invites in March 2023. A 2026 invite-only test pays some creators for reels, photos and carousels based on engagement. Recent '$10,000 for Reels' headlines recycle a 2021 story.
findings.note: Meta reportedly confirmed the test to Business Insider; I saw this only second-hand. The article date, payout schedule and collab exclusion are unconfirmed. The only real check is Professional Dashboard > Bonuses. Do not plan revenue around it.

findings.claim: No official Instagram page found this session gives a follower minimum for creator Subscriptions. Third-party 2026 guides cite 10,000 followers.
findings.note: Unlikely to be a meaningful lever in months 1 to 3 for a hype/news account (judgment).

findings.claim: Meta Creator Marketplace (brand deals) publishes no follower minimum. Creators need a professional account and must meet the Partner Monetization Policies, which require an 'authentic, established presence', including a 'sufficient follower base'.
findings.note: Policies: https://www.facebook.com/help/instagram/512371932629820 . Eligibility for partnership ads and branded content: https://help.instagram.com/1372533836927082

findings.claim: Facebook Content Monetization, which pays on reels, stories, and photo and text posts, is still invite-only. Creators can only submit an interest form (Professional Dashboard > Monetization > Content Monetization), and accepting the terms does not guarantee eligibility or payment.
findings.note: Also https://creators.facebook.com/introducing-facebook-content-monetization and the terms at https://www.facebook.com/legal/creator_content_monetization_terms . Thresholds quoted by third parties (5K or 10K followers, 600K minutes watched) are unverified.

findings.claim: Meta's Partner Monetization Policies require an established presence of at least 30 days, residence in an eligible country, and content that is original or meaningfully enhanced. You may monetize only content you created, were involved in creating, or that features you.
findings.note: Reels made mostly of Rockstar trailer footage risk being ineligible. Your own script and voice over generated visuals should count as your creation, but quoted official footage needs clear commentary (judgment).

findings.claim: Facebook Creator Fast Track gives guaranteed monthly pay for 3 months for posting Facebook reels on 10 separate days a month. Requirements: residence in the US, Canada, UK or Australia; age 18+; a Facebook Page; a Facebook account at least 30 days old; no Facebook reel posted in the past 6 months; and at least 20,000 followers plus 30,000 video views in the last 60 days on Instagram, TikTok or YouTube. The program page lists $100 to $450 per month for 20K to 99,999 followers and $1,000 per month for 100K to 999,999. The March 2026 announcement adds $3,000 per month at 1M+.
findings.note: Announcement: https://about.fb.com/news/2026/03/creator-fast-track-grow-your-audience-earn-money-on-facebook/ . The pages disagree on tiers, and content must be 'filmed or created by you'. Not verified: whether it still accepts applications as of Nov 2026, and whether reels auto-shared from Instagram count as 'posting a Facebook reel'.

findings.claim: Facebook's Breakthrough bonus (up to $5,000 over the first 90 days for new US creators) stopped accepting applications on February 26, 2026.
findings.note: Older creators.facebook.com pages still advertise it.

findings.claim: Amazon Associates US standard commission rates: physical video games and video game consoles 1%; digital video games and televisions 2%; headphones 3%. Commission is paid on the sale price.
findings.note: The page metadata is about 512 days old. The rate for controllers and accessories was not verified; check the category in Associates Central. A separate onsite rate schedule is lower (consoles 0.5%).

findings.claim: At those rates a $70 game earns about $0.70, a $500 console about $5 and a $100 headset about $3. Earning $100 in commission takes roughly 143 game sales or 34 headset sales.
findings.note: Prices are illustrative; the GTA 6 retail price was not verified this session. If Amazon sells GTA 6 as a digital code, the 2% digital rate would double the commission per copy (availability unverified).

findings.claim: Associates rules to plan around: (1) post the required statement 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases' wherever links appear, such as the bio-link page; (2) new accounts are closed unless they refer 3 qualifying sales within 180 days; (3) the standard cookie lasts 24 hours, extended to 89 days if the item is added to the cart.
findings.note: From prior knowledge; not re-checked this session because the search budget ran out.

findings.claim: FTC influencer guidance: disclose any material connection (affiliate commission, free product, paid deal) clearly in the post itself. For video, the disclosure belongs in the video, spoken and on screen, not only in the caption, description or bio. A platform's paid-partnership tool alone may not be enough.
findings.note: Official page recalled from prior knowledge, not fetched this session.

findings.claim: The FTC's Consumer Reviews and Testimonials Rule (16 CFR Part 465, in effect since October 2024) bans buying or selling fake indicators of social media influence, such as bot followers or views, for commercial use.
findings.note: From prior knowledge, not fetched. It is relevant because growth-hack services are common in launch-hype niches.

findings.claim: Week 1 (Nov 12 to 19): the realistic platform income is $0. A brand-new account cannot join any program and be paid within 7 days. At most it can reach Instagram's 500-follower Gifts gate and start Amazon referrals.
findings.note: Derived from the official thresholds in this stream: TikTok 10K followers + 100K views in 30 days; YouTube 500 subscribers + 3M Shorts views in 90 days as the minimum; Instagram Gifts 500 followers + payout account. I found no sourced base rates for how fast new accounts grow.

findings.claim: Month 1 (to about Dec 12): with no breakout video, expect $0 to tens of dollars from Gifts and a few affiliate sales. With one or more breakout videos (roughly 1M+ views), the account can clear the TikTok Creator Rewards and Gifts gates. Creator Rewards then pays only after enrollment and only on original videos of 60 s or more. At an assumed $0.40 to $1.00 per 1,000 qualified views, each 1M qualified views is worth about $400 to $1,000.
findings.note: The $0.40 to $1.00 range is a commonly cited third-party figure that I could not verify this session; TikTok guarantees no rate. Payouts generally arrive the following month or later (unverified), so most month-1 earnings land in month 2.

findings.claim: Month 3 (to about Feb 12, 2027): for an account that broke out at launch, a realistic stack is TikTok Creator Rewards, plus Facebook Creator Fast Track ($100 to $450 per month at 20K to 99,999 followers, if eligible and still open), plus a first few small brand deals and minor affiliate income. YouTube Shorts ad income is unlikely, because from Feb 1, 2027 the Shorts pool pays only channels with 10M qualified Shorts views per trailing 90 days. As launch hype fades, views must come from evergreen GTA 6 content.
findings.note: Ad-funded payouts (TikTok Creator Rewards, YouTube, Facebook) are commonly reported to dip in Q1 after Q4 holiday ad spending (unverified industry pattern).

findings.claim: US tax: net self-employment earnings of $400 or more trigger self-employment tax of 15.3% (12.4% Social Security up to the annual wage base plus 2.9% Medicare), reported on Schedule SE along with Schedule C. Estimated tax payments are generally due if you expect to owe $1,000 or more for the year.
findings.note: Official IRS page recalled from prior knowledge, not fetched this session. Nonresident aliens for tax purposes, which includes most F-1 students in their first 5 calendar years, are generally not subject to SE tax but face other rules (IRS Publication 519). The immigration restriction applies regardless.

findings.claim: All creator income is taxable whether or not a form is issued. Brands and platforms report on Form 1099-NEC or 1099-MISC; under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, the threshold rises from $600 to $2,000 for payments made after Dec 31, 2025. Payment processors use Form 1099-K, whose threshold was restored to more than $20,000 and 200 transactions.
findings.note: From prior knowledge of the 2025 law and the IRS page; not fetched this session. Platforms also collect a W-9 (US persons) or W-8BEN (non-US persons) before paying.

findings.claim: USCIS: F-1 students may not work off campus during their first academic year. On-campus employment is allowed with restrictions. Off-campus work is permitted only with specific authorization: Curricular Practical Training, Optional Practical Training (pre- or post-completion, plus the STEM OPT extension), or severe-economic-hardship or special-student-relief authorization.
findings.note: Official page recalled from prior knowledge, not fetched this session. Monetized creator activity (platform revenue shares, brand deals, affiliate commissions) is generally treated as self-employment, which needs authorization. SEVP guidance allows self-employment in limited cases such as post-completion OPT (unverified). Confirm with the school's DSO or an immigration attorney before enrolling in any payout program.

findings.claim: Under 8 CFR 214.1(e), any unauthorized employment by a nonimmigrant is a failure to maintain status, and a nonimmigrant permitted to work may do only the employment that has been authorized.
findings.note: Regulation text recalled from prior knowledge, not fetched. ICE SEVP's Study in the States page 'Working in the United States' also says F-1 students must be authorized before working. URL from memory: https://studyinthestates.dhs.gov/students/work/working-in-the-united-states (not fetched).

recommendations: This week, before Nov 19: set up Instagram as a Creator professional account. Set up TikTok as a personal account, because business accounts are barred from Creator Rewards; TikTok also reportedly shows a bio link on personal accounts only from 1,000 followers (unverified). Create the YouTube channel. Fill in payout and tax profiles early, since they gate payments later. Apply to Amazon Associates listing all three profiles. Build a bio-link page that carries the Associates statement and a plain line saying 'I earn commissions'.

Make every narrative reel 61 to 90 seconds (the reference is 81 s) so the TikTok version counts for Creator Rewards. Never rely on Duets or Stitches for money. Give every AI still real motion, because Instagram does not pay for static-image videos. Keep Rockstar footage to brief excerpts with commentary, because Meta pays only for content you created or meaningfully enhanced.

Hold off on Facebook: do not turn on automatic Instagram-to-Facebook reel sharing yet. When any one platform passes 20,000 followers with 30,000+ views in 60 days, apply to Creator Fast Track (US/CA/UK/AU). It pays $100 to $450 per month for 3 months at 20K to 99,999 followers and $1,000 at 100K+, and requires reels on 10 separate days a month. Submit the Content Monetization interest form at the same time. First confirm that Fast Track is still open and how it treats reels auto-shared from Instagram.

Treat YouTube Shorts as reach. The realistic money target is the unchanged fan-funding tier: 500 subscribers, 3 uploads and 3M Shorts views in 90 days. If the channel is on pace for 1,000 subscribers and 10M Shorts views in 90 days by mid-January 2027, apply before Feb 1 to avoid the new 20M entry bar. Even then, Shorts pay after Feb 1 needs 10M qualified views per trailing 90 days.

Affiliate: plan one Black Friday / Cyber Monday 'GTA 6 setup' reel (Nov 27 to 30) that points to headsets and accessories, which earn 3% versus 1% on consoles and games. Disclose in the video by voice and on-screen text. Set expectations at tens to low hundreds of dollars from Amazon in month 1 (estimate). Higher-rate retailer or brand programs and TikTok Shop are worth checking (unverified).

Sponsorships: join Meta Creator Marketplace and YouTube Creator Partnerships as soon as eligible. Price deals on trailing median views, CPM-style, rather than follower count, and ask for the brand's budget first. Use the platform's paid-partnership label plus a spoken disclosure. Decline sellers of GTA money, modded accounts, grey-market keys or gambling offers, which carry terms-of-service and brand-safety risk (judgment).

Digital products: do not sell anything carrying Rockstar logos, key art or AI likenesses of GTA characters, because of trademark and copyright risk (judgment). Lower-risk options are a free launch checklist used to build an email list, and a paid 'how these AI reels are made' pack (prompts, ffmpeg recipes, voice workflow) aimed at other creators, which needs no Rockstar IP.

Expectations to give the user: week 1 about $0. Month 1 ranges from $0 to low hundreds of dollars unless a video breaks out; each 1M Creator Rewards-qualified TikTok views is about $400 to $1,000 at an assumed rate that I could not verify. Month 3 could be a stack of Creator Rewards, Fast Track and 1 to 3 small brand deals. Payouts typically land 30 to 60 days after the month they are earned (unverified).

Compliance comes before money. If the creator is in F-1 status, turn on no payout program, affiliate account or paid deal until the school's DSO or an immigration attorney confirms work authorization (for example OPT). Otherwise, treat all of it as self-employment income: track it, and set aside money for 15.3% SE tax plus income tax.

Verify in a follow-up pass: the TikTok Shop affiliate threshold and commissions for PS5 and Xbox accessories, 2026 sponsorship rate benchmarks for gaming creators, current Creator Rewards, Shorts and Facebook Reels RPMs, Amazon's operating rules, and the IRS, USCIS and FTC pages. None of these could be fetched this session.

examples.name: Reel by Unseen. (@unseenbyneuralway), the reference reel
examples.metrics: From the workflow context: 81 s, 720x1280, about 22,289 likes and 149 comments on 2026-11-12, posted 2026-11-11, view count not exposed. Not re-measured in this stream.
examples.what_works: Fit with monetization rules: the 81 s length clears TikTok Creator Rewards' 1-minute minimum, so the same video can earn on TikTok. Original narration over generated visuals fits Meta's 'content you created or meaningfully enhanced' rule better than trailer re-cuts would. The daily countdown series builds returning viewers, and the view gates reward exactly that: 100K views in 30 days on TikTok, 3M or 10M Shorts views in 90 days on YouTube, and 30K views in 60 days for Fast Track. research.summary: Instagram's guidance has been consistent from Mosseri's January 2025 statement through his four-part ranking video series in September 2026. Reach depends on watch time, sends per reach and likes per reach. Sends count most with non-followers, who make up nearly all of a new account's audience, and creators are told to aim for engagement rate rather than raw views. The September 2026 series adds four principles that help this project if it is done cleanly: originality, recency, 'breaking content' (Instagram shows small creators' public posts to non-followers and widens the ones that beat expectations) and larger AI models. Recency now has a number: on Meta's October 21, 2026 earnings call, nearly 45% of recommended Instagram Reels were less than a day old, up more than 11 points from Q2. So posting within hours of launch news matters more than picking the right clock time. Since the April 30, 2026 originality update, accounts that mostly post other people's content, or content they haven't meaningfully changed, are no longer recommended to non-followers, judged over roughly the last 30 days. Adding credits, subtitles or a watermark to someone else's clip reportedly doesn't count as changing it, so raw Rockstar trailer clips put reach at risk, while original scripts, the user's own voice and original AI visuals are safe. Hashtags are capped at 5 and help Instagram sort content but don't add reach, so 'GTA 6' and the topic need to be spoken, shown on screen and placed in the first caption line. Linked Reels were removed on October 28, 2026 and Meta's 'Series' feature is only a limited test, so the countdown has to hold together on its own through covers, numbering, sign-off, pinned posts and the Stories countdown sticker. Trial Reels need a public professional account, eligibility for recommendations and a follower count that sources disagree on (200 or 1,000), so plan week one without them. Keep reels under 3 minutes, since longer ones are reportedly not recommended to new audiences; the reference format (81 s, about 185 words per minute, speech starting at 0.14 s, a cut about every 6 s) fits the watch-time and sends model. The main things that kill reach for GTA content are reposted or copyright-claimed footage and music (claims can affect Account Status), violent or sexual images that can trip recommendation and teen filters (unverified), undisclosed photoreal AI, and engagement bait. Research was limited: the shared web-search budget ran out partway through, and WebFetch was blocked for creators.instagram.com, tubefilter.com and petapixel.com. Claims marked unverified come from background knowledge and should be checked before they drive decisions.

findings.claim: Mosseri (Jan 2025): the three most important ranking signals are watch time, likes and sends, and creators should track average watch time, likes per reach and sends per reach in Insights. Likes matter slightly more for reach among followers (connected), and sends slightly more for reach among non-followers (unconnected).
findings.note: Quotes carried by Social Media Today; the primary source is Mosseri's own video, which was not opened. Almost all of a brand-new account's reach is unconnected, so sends per reach is the lead number to watch. A 2026 summary by Kompozy (kompozy.io/news/instagram-mosseri-ranking-signals-guidance) ranks the signals for non-follower reach as sends per reach, then likes per reach, then watch time; that is a blog summary and unverified.

findings.claim: Mosseri (2024 Q&A): in his experience, sends per reach correlates with overall reach more than any other metric.
findings.note: Timeline by an industry analyst, quoting Mosseri.

findings.claim: In September 2026 Mosseri posted a four-part video series on how Instagram ranks content (part 1 on Sept 3, part 4 on Sept 24 or 25). Part 2 named four principles beyond engagement: originality, recency, 'breaking content' and larger AI models.
findings.note: Dates for parts 2 to 4 differ by a day between outlets. The list of four principles is the same everywhere, including socialmediatoday.com/news/instagram-chief-shares-algorithm-insights-and-posting-tips/831326/. Instagram published no weights for them.

findings.claim: 'Breaking content' means Instagram shows public posts from small creators to people who don't follow them, to see how they respond and help new creators get noticed. One summary says that if a post does better than expected with that outside audience, the test is repeated with more people.
findings.note: The 'repeated with more people' detail comes from a blog summary (bazzaal.com/blog/instagram-algorithm-2026-mosseri) and is unverified. What it means here: each reel from a new account gets its own test with non-followers, and how it does against expectations, not follower count, decides whether it spreads.

findings.claim: Part 4 of the series covered how creators can get reach: Mosseri told them to watch engagement rate rather than chase raw views or likes.
findings.note: Our inference: filler posts lower the account's rates, so they have a cost; bought followers and engagement pods also drag down per-reach rates.

findings.claim: Part 3 covered controls viewers use to change their recommendations: Favorites, Not Interested, and 'Your Algorithm' (users see and edit the topics Instagram thinks they like). Your Algorithm started in Reels, reached Explore in April 2026 and is rolling out to the main feed.
findings.note: The official announcement page exists. Rollout dates come from Metricool (metricool.com/instagram-news/) and bazzaal.com. Because topic matching matters, 'GTA 6' and video games must be obvious from the speech, on-screen text and caption.

findings.claim: Meta's Q3 2026 earnings call (Oct 21, 2026): 'Nearly 45% of recommended Instagram Reels are now less than one day old, up more than 11 percentage points from Q2.'
findings.note: Wording matches the official transcript (seen through search; the PDF itself was not opened). This is the strongest evidence that posting quickly after news beats optimizing the clock time during the launch window.

findings.claim: On the same call, Meta said a new recommendation architecture covers about a quarter of unconnected Feed views and half of Reels views, raising Reels watch time by 1%. Its Q3 relevance launches raised time spent on Reels by over 4%.
findings.note: Taken from transcript summaries (Benzinga, Motley Fool, StockAnalysis). It confirms the ranking models changed this autumn, so tactics from before 2026 may no longer work.

findings.claim: April 30, 2026 originality update: Instagram extended its limits on reposted content from Reels to photos and carousels. Accounts that mostly share content they didn't create, or haven't meaningfully changed, are no longer recommended to non-followers. How their followers see them doesn't change.
findings.note: Also reported by Tubefilter (tubefilter.com/2026/04/30/instagram-removes-algorithm-recommendations-repost-content-aggregator/amp/). Coverage quotes Mosseri: 'I recommend looking for ways to make content your own so you can continue to be recommended to people who don't follow you.'

findings.claim: The 2026 originality check looks at the mix of an account's posts over a rolling window of about 30 days. Eligibility returns once the recent mix is mostly original.
findings.note: Blog summary, consistent with the 30-day aggregator rule from 2024. What it means here: post no reposts at all in the account's first 30 days.

findings.claim: Adding a border, watermark, subtitles or a credit line on its own does not count as meaningfully changing someone else's content.
findings.note: Blog guide, said to follow TechCrunch's coverage. This applies directly to Rockstar trailer footage: a raw clip with captions and a credit still counts as unoriginal.

findings.claim: Rules from 2024 still apply: aggregator accounts that repost content they didn't create 10 or more times in 30 days are dropped from recommendations. When identical content exists, Instagram recommends the original, and reposts get a label linking back to the original creator.
findings.note: Accounts with permission to repost were exempt under the 2024 rules. Our inference: post on Instagram before other platforms so that no one copying the video can upload it to Instagram first.

findings.claim: Hashtags are capped at 5 per post or Reel, down from 30. @creators announced the cap on Dec 18, 2025 with a gradual rollout, to curb hashtag stuffing and spam.
findings.note: Also reported by Business Today (Dec 19, 2025). A few guides still give 30, citing an old help or developer page, so check in the app.

findings.claim: Mosseri's position: hashtags help Instagram categorize content and can help search, but they don't meaningfully increase reach.
findings.note: Coverage says he said this in Feb 2025 and again in an AMA; the primary video was not checked.

findings.claim: Trial Reels (launched Dec 10, 2024) are shown only to non-followers at first. Results appear after about 24 hours, and the creator can let Instagram share the reel with followers automatically if it does well within 72 hours. A professional account is required, though some non-professional creators have access in tests.
findings.note: The official explainer is creators.instagram.com/blog/instagram-trial-reels, but WebFetch could not reach it in this session. A 2026 summary warns that running the same video as a Trial Reel more than once doesn't help reach (unverified).

findings.claim: Trial Reels eligibility: a public professional account that is eligible for recommendations (losing eligibility removes access). Sources disagree on the follower minimum: guides citing the Help Center say 200 for professional accounts (1,000 for personal), while others, including a report of an expansion in early 2026, say 1,000.
findings.note: A new account starting at 0 followers should expect no Trial Reels in week one. postfa.st reports that scheduling for Trial Reels arrived in Feb 2026 (unverified).

findings.claim: Linked Reels, the Aug 2025 feature that chained reels into a series with 'part 2' links, were removed on Oct 28, 2026 according to an in-app notice. Existing links disappeared; the reels, their views and insights were not affected.
findings.note: Also reported by selfemployed.com and Metricool; no official blog post was found. The reference creator's 'day N' series therefore has no built-in linking.

findings.claim: Meta began testing 'Series' on Instagram and Facebook on June 2, 2026. It groups episodic reels in a dedicated section of the creator's profile and prompts viewers to keep watching while they browse Reels. It is a limited test with no rollout date and has not been confirmed as the replacement for Linked Reels.
findings.note: Check the Reel composer for a Series option and use it if it appears.

findings.claim: Reels longer than 3 minutes can be posted but are not recommended to new audiences.
findings.note: A blog citing the Help Center (Oct 2026). From background knowledge, 3 minutes has been the longest length eligible for recommendation since the January 2025 extension.

findings.claim: Meta publishes AI system cards explaining how Instagram ranks content on Feed, Feed Recommendations, Stories, Explore, Reels Chaining, Search, Suggested Accounts and Notifications. Each surface makes several predictions from thousands of signals, and the models change often.
findings.note: The current cards are at transparency.meta.com/features/explaining-ranking (not fetched).

findings.claim: Instagram's 2023 'Ranking Explained' post said the most important Reels predictions are how likely a viewer is to reshare, watch to the end, like, and go to the audio page. Inputs include an analysis of the reel's video and information about the account that posted it.
findings.source_url: none: background knowledge of the official about.instagram.com post (May 2023); not re-verified this session
findings.note: Consistent with the 2025 and 2026 statements. Our inference: because visits to the audio page count, a named, reusable original audio track may help.

findings.claim: Whether an account can be recommended is decided at the account level and shown in Settings > Account Status. Instagram's creator blog explains how to stay eligible.
findings.note: The Settings path comes from Trial Reels guides; the blog itself was not fetched because the host was blocked. Check Account Status before the first post and after any copyright or guideline notice.

findings.claim: Instagram's Recommendations Guidelines keep some content that doesn't break the Community Guidelines out of recommendations to non-followers. This includes violent or graphic, sexually suggestive, regulated-goods, and misleading or clickbait content, plus content from accounts with recent violations. Teen accounts default to content guided by PG-13 ratings (Oct 2025).
findings.source_url: none: background knowledge of the help.instagram.com Recommendations Guidelines and the Oct 2025 teen-accounts update; not re-verified this session
findings.note: Highly relevant to GTA: shootouts, gore, drug use, strip clubs and suggestive images are the likely triggers, especially in the first frame and on covers.

findings.claim: Meta requires creators to disclose photorealistic video or realistic-sounding audio that was made or altered digitally (the 'AI info' label), may penalize creators who don't, and labels files automatically when they carry C2PA or IPTC AI metadata.
findings.source_url: none: background knowledge of Meta's Feb 2024 AI-labeling policy; not re-verified this session
findings.note: No official statement was found saying the label lowers distribution. A cloned voice combined with photoreal Higgsfield shots very likely requires disclosure.

findings.claim: Instagram's long-standing Reels guidance: reels that visibly come from other apps (with their logos or watermarks), are low resolution or blurry, have borders, or are mostly covered in text are shown to fewer people.
findings.source_url: none: background knowledge of Instagram @creators Reels tips (2021); not re-verified this session
findings.note: The reference reel is 720x1280. Publish at 1080x1920 with 'Upload at highest quality' turned on.

findings.claim: YouTube Shorts can run up to 3 minutes since Oct 15, 2024, but Shorts over 1 minute with an active Content ID claim are blocked. In July 2025 YouTube renamed 'repetitious content' to 'inauthentic content' in its Partner Program policy. Also in July 2025, Facebook cut distribution and monetization for accounts that repeatedly reuse other people's content.
findings.source_url: none: background knowledge; not re-verified this session
findings.note: If a cut includes any Rockstar trailer footage, keep the YouTube version to 60 seconds or less, or take the footage out.

findings.claim: Since July 10, 2025, photos and videos from public professional accounts can appear in Google search results, with a setting to opt out.
findings.source_url: none: background knowledge; not re-verified this session
findings.note: This makes keyword-first captions and on-screen titles more valuable for how-to content after launch.

findings.claim: The profile grid has shown 3:4 portrait thumbnails since Jan 2025, so a 9:16 Reel cover is cropped at the top and bottom on the grid.
findings.source_url: none: background knowledge; not re-verified this session
findings.note: Keep the cover title and episode number inside the central 1080x1440 area.

findings.claim: Edits, Instagram's free editing app launched in Apr 2025, exports without a watermark and shows Reels insights. No official evidence was found that reels made in Edits get a ranking boost.
findings.source_url: none: background knowledge; not re-verified this session
findings.note: Exports from ffmpeg are fine; what matters is that no other platform's watermark appears.

findings.claim: Instagram Gifts (payments from fans on Reels) require a professional account, age 18 or older, and at least 500 followers.
findings.note: This is the earliest built-in monetization threshold a new account can reach within the 14 days.

findings.claim: Other Instagram changes in 2026: tests of a home screen that opens on Reels, a long-form horizontal 'Features' format (up to 90 minutes, select US creators), Reels on TV, and a Reels Watch History (July 2026).
findings.note: Context only: Instagram keeps adding Reels inventory and viewing time, but none of these changes the plan for a new account.

examples.name: Reference: @unseenbyneuralway ('Unseen.') day-3 countdown reel, posted 2026-11-11
examples.what_works: It lines up with every signal Instagram names. Speech starts at 0.14 s with a hook that talks to the viewer directly, which protects the first seconds. A cut roughly every 6 s plus a second hook at the midpoint holds watch time. One checkable number that shocks (2^128 keys, about 10.8 trillion years) is the kind of thing people screenshot and send, which drives sends per reach. A numbered daily sign-off builds a habit of coming back and visiting the profile, which supports recency and follows. The caption separates the creator's own maths from what is on the record, which builds trust and keeps misinformation risk low. Weak spot: it was exported at 720x1280. Borrowing the format is fine for the algorithm; copying the script, tagline or look is not.
examples.metrics: 81 s, 720x1280, 243 words (about 185 words per minute), about 13 cuts. About 22,289 likes and 149 comments roughly one day after posting. These figures came with the task and were not re-checked; view count is not public. A like-to-comment ratio of about 150:1 suggests people watch and share rather than argue.

recommendations: SETUP: Make the account a public Professional account of the Creator type. Creator rather than Business reportedly keeps access to the wider in-app music library (unverified). Put 'GTA 6' in the Name field. Confirm that Settings > Account Status says the account is eligible for recommendations. Turn on 'Upload at highest quality'. Link a Facebook Page in Accounts Center so reels can be shared to Facebook natively. Leave the Google search visibility setting on.

ORIGINALITY: Treat originality as a budget for the whole account. In the first 30 days post no reposts and no Rockstar clips that haven't been reworked. Every reel should be the creator's own script, own cloned voice and own AI visuals and edit. If official footage is used at all, keep it a short insert with commentary, never the main material; credits, subtitles or watermarks don't make it original. Never reuse another creator's clip. Don't copy the reference creator's scripts, tagline ('the part of GTA 6 you never see') or visual identity; borrowing the format is fine for the algorithm.

SAFE VISUALS: Show the world, not the violence. Avoid gore, guns pointed at the camera, drug use and nudity or suggestive outfits, above all in the first frame and on covers. GTA's adult themes are the most likely reason a reel would be held back from recommendations or teen feeds (inferred from the guidelines; unverified).

FIRST 3 SECONDS: Start speaking in the first frame (the reference starts at 0.14 s), with no logo or intro card. Within 2 seconds show a 4 to 7 word title that says 'GTA 6' plus a number, or that puts the viewer in the stakes. Cut every 4 to 6 seconds. Keep burned-in captions in the lower third and never cover most of the frame with text. Export at 1080x1920.

DESIGN FOR SENDS: Build each episode around one thing people will want to send: a useful fact (unlock time by time zone, download size, editions), a myth-versus-fact debate, or a shocking number. Let the content prompt the send. Avoid explicit 'share this' or 'comment X' requests, which may count as engagement bait (unverified risk).

LENGTH: Make the main daily reel 60 to 90 seconds at about 170 to 190 words per minute, like the reference. Make companion shorts 15 to 35 seconds with one fact each. Never go over 3 minutes. If the main reel's average watch time stays below about a third of its length for three episodes in a row, cut to 45 to 60 seconds (estimate).

SEARCH: Use at most 5 specific hashtags. Say the search phrase in the first spoken sentence, put it in the on-screen title and in the first caption line. Name the original audio after the series if the rename option is available.

SERIES WITHOUT LINKS: Linked Reels were removed on Oct 28, 2026. Instead use the same cover template every day with a large T-minus number and the same closing line. Pin the newest episode and a 'start here' reel (there are 3 pin slots). Add a Stories countdown sticker set to launch, which followers can tap for a reminder, and a Countdown Highlight. Use Meta's 'Series' option if the composer shows it. Count down (T-6, T-5 and so on) rather than up, to stand apart from the reference.

TRIAL REELS: Check the 'Trial' toggle in the composer every day. Once it appears (at 200 or 1,000 followers; sources disagree), use it only for clearly different hooks or edits of topics that already worked, with automatic sharing to followers turned on. Never run the same file as a trial twice or re-upload a reel that flopped; re-cut the first 3 seconds and the cover instead.

CADENCE: Post one main reel a day at a fixed time, plus one short on days with news; post three on launch day and no more than two on other days. Mosseri says creators should watch engagement rate, so drop anything that is filler.

TIMING: Freshness counts for more than the time of day; aim to publish within 1 to 3 hours of any news from Rockstar or the console platforms. For the fixed daily slot, test 12:00 ET against 18:00 ET on days 1 to 4 and keep the better one. Switch to the 'Most active times' figures in Insights once they appear. This is an estimate; no verified 2026 dataset of US posting times was found.

CROSS-POSTING: Publish on Instagram first and share the same reel to Facebook with the built-in option. Upload clean ffmpeg exports to TikTok and YouTube Shorts 30 to 60 minutes later, never a file downloaded from Instagram or TikTok, which carries their watermark. Keep any YouTube cut that contains Rockstar footage to 60 seconds or less. Apply each platform's AI label.

AI DISCLOSURE: Turn on Instagram's AI label for every reel with photoreal Higgsfield footage or the cloned voice. Add a small 'AI visualization' tag on screen so the footage is never mistaken for leaked gameplay.

AUDIO: Don't build copyrighted songs, including the songs from the GTA trailers, into the ffmpeg export. Add music inside Instagram from its library at low volume, or use original or royalty-free music. This avoids mutes and copyright claims that can affect Account Status.

METRICS LOOP: 24 hours after each post, record views, the share of views from non-followers, average watch time, skip rate if Instagram shows it, sends per reach, likes per reach and follows per reach. Rank topics by sends per reach. For any reel at twice the account's typical (median) result or better, post a follow-up on the same topic within 24 hours. For any reel whose skip rate is above the account's typical level, re-cut the opening.

research.summary: Voice: ElevenLabs' Eleven v4 (launched 2026-09-28 per ElevenLabs' v4 page and press coverage; reported) is the model to test first for a cinematic narrator. It makes instant clones from about 10 s of audio and takes inline audio tags, but it has no SSML <break> and reportedly no speed control. Higgsfield already offers it (confirmed today: Eleven v4 and v4 Turbo, with only stability and similarity_boost adjustable, a 10,000-character cap, and cloned 'reference element' voices allowed). For the clone itself, follow ElevenLabs' instant-clone guidance (confirmed via search excerpts of the docs): 1-2 minutes of clean single-speaker audio at -23 to -18 dB RMS with a -3 dB true peak, steady tone, read in exactly the delivery you want back. A ready-to-read 230-word original sample script is in the recommendations, in reply to the user's offer to record now. Pace: the reference runs about 180 wpm overall (243 words in 81 s, about 185 wpm while speaking), so budget about 185 words per 60 s and fix a slow take in post with ffmpeg atempo 1.05-1.10, since the voice model has no speed setting. Export one master for all three apps: 1080x1920, H.264 High, SDR BT.709, constant 30 fps (or 24 if every source is 24), AAC 48 kHz; the command is verified locally. Keep text inside Meta's Reels safe box (14% top, 35% bottom, 6% sides, i.e. x 65-1015 and y 269-1248 px; reported, and published for ads only), using 2-4-word phrase captions with the spoken word highlighted plus big numeral cards on each number reveal, rendered as ASS subtitles through ffmpeg (tested). Audio: duck the music bed 12-20 dB under the voice and master to -14 LUFS with true peak at or below -1 dB using two-pass loudnorm; my local chain measured exactly -14.0 LUFS and -3.8 dBTP. Visuals: make 9:16 stills first, then animate them image-to-video on Higgsfield's current lineup (confirmed today): Kling 4.0 (3-30 s, start and end frames) as the workhorse, Seedance 2.5's 480p draft-then-finalize mode to save credits, Veo 3.1 (4/6/8 s, start frame only) for hero shots, and Cinema Studio 3.5's hyper_neon or cold_steel grades. Render clips silent, add every word of text in ffmpeg, and deflicker or upscale only the shots that make the cut. Rhythm: the reference averages about 6 s per shot; aim for a visual change every 2-4 s, with 2-3 in the first 3 s, and end on a frame that matches the opening. Caveat: the shared web-search budget ran out mid-stream, and elevenlabs.io and docs.cloud.google.com were blocked for direct reads, so vendor prompt-guide details and a few platform specs below are marked unverified; those hosts must be allowed in the session's network settings (or a follow-up message can continue the searches) to verify them.

findings.claim: ElevenLabs instant-clone (IVC) guidance: about 1-2 minutes of good audio is recommended. Total runtime matters, not the number of files. Use one speaker, no background noise, loud and clear. Keep quality and tone consistent, because very dynamic audio (wide pitch and volume swings) gives less predictable clones. Unusual voices or accents may need Professional Voice Cloning (30-180 minutes of audio).
findings.note: Read through search-result excerpts of the official docs; direct fetch of elevenlabs.io is blocked in this session.

findings.claim: ElevenLabs recording targets for cloning: -23 to -18 dB RMS with a true peak of -3 dB; MP3 at 192 kbps or higher. Uncompressed WAV usually does not improve clone quality and can cause upload problems.
findings.note: Via official-doc search excerpts (direct fetch blocked).

findings.claim: ElevenLabs help center: some users got excellent clones from about 30 s samples, while some 10-minute uploads gave worse results, so more audio is not automatically better for an instant clone.
findings.note: Via search excerpt. ElevenLabs' voice-cloning landing page (https://elevenlabs.io/voice-cloning) also says an instant voice can be made from a 10-second recording and that 1-5 minutes of clear audio gives good results (marketing page).

findings.claim: Eleven v4 and Eleven v4 Turbo launched on 2026-09-28. ElevenLabs says v4 instant clones work from about 10 s of audio and outperform Multilingual v2 professional clones, that professional clones (not supported in v3) are back, and that v4 covers 90+ languages; v4 Turbo targets about 100 ms median latency.
findings.note: Official page seen only via search excerpts; matches coverage at https://www.unite.ai/elevenlabs-launches-eleven-v4-with-low-latency-turbo-variant/. The quality claims are ElevenLabs' own.

findings.claim: In Eleven v4, SSML <break> tags are disabled; inline audio tags such as [whispers] or [sighs], plus punctuation, control delivery. A third-party model page says v4 has no speed control.
findings.note: Search excerpts also attribute the break-tag point to elevenlabs.io/v4. Consistent with Higgsfield's v4 integration exposing no speed or style parameter (confirmed, see the Higgsfield finding).

findings.claim: Coverage says every Eleven v4 clone, instant or professional, needs verified consent from the voice's owner. Guides disagree on whether an instant clone needs a spoken verification phrase or just a rights checkbox.
findings.note: Conflicting secondary sources. Harmless here, since it is the user's own voice, but expect a verification step when creating the clone.

findings.claim: Higgsfield's live catalog today lists Eleven v4 (up to 10 voices) and Eleven v4 Turbo (one voice) for speech. Both take up to 10,000 characters per request and a preset or workspace 'reference element' (cloned) voice, expose only stability and similarity_boost (0-1), and return up to 4 variations per call (batch_size). The catalog also lists ElevenLabs Music v2 and v2.5 (3-600 s, instrumental option, up to 4 variations). The Mirelo sound-effects model is marked 'Game pipeline only'.
findings.source_url: Higgsfield MCP models_explore, live catalog read 2026-11-12 through the user's connected account (read-only, no credits used; no public URL)
findings.note: Higgsfield's Create Voice widget (record or upload) makes cloned voices usable there. An ElevenLabs-side clone probably does not carry over to Higgsfield automatically (not tested).

findings.claim: ElevenLabs voice-setting defaults: stability 0.5, similarity 0.75, style 0, speaker boost on, speed 1.0. The docs suggest starting near 50/75/0 and recommend keeping style exaggeration at 0. Lower stability gives more varied delivery. High similarity on noisy source audio copies the artifacts. In Eleven v3, similarity, speaker boost and speed are unavailable, and stability (Creative/Natural/Robust) is the main control.
findings.note: Via official-doc search excerpts.

findings.claim: ElevenLabs best practices: Eleven v3 does not support SSML break tags (use audio tags and punctuation instead). On Multilingual v2 and Flash, <break time='x.xs' /> gives pauses of up to 3 s, but too many breaks in one generation can cause speed-ups, noises or artifacts.
findings.note: Via official-doc search excerpts. A dedicated normalization page exists (https://elevenlabs.io/docs/best-practices/prompting/normalization) but its content was not retrieved; spell numbers out to be safe.

findings.claim: ElevenLabs' v3 launch post said professional clones were not fully optimized for v3 and recommended instant clones or designed voices with v3.
findings.note: Matters only if v3 is chosen over v4.

findings.claim: Eleven v4 API list price is reported at $0.08 per 1,000 characters ($0.04 for v4 Turbo). An 80 s script is about 1,300-1,350 characters, so roughly $0.10-0.11 per full pass before regenerations.
findings.note: Third-party price page; subscription and Higgsfield credit maths not confirmed. The per-reel figure is my calculation from the 230-word sample script (1,309 characters).

findings.claim: Third-party specs for Instagram Reels agree on 1080x1920 (9:16), MP4 with H.264 video and AAC audio, 30 fps typical, and files up to 4 GB. Their recommended video bitrates vary widely, from about 3.5 to 15 Mbps.
findings.note: No Meta Help Center spec page was retrieved; Instagram re-encodes uploads anyway. The reference reel was delivered at 720x1280, which is normal for Instagram's playback renditions, so still upload at 1080x1920.

findings.claim: Reels length: several 2026 guides cite uploads of up to 20 minutes. Mosseri announced 3-minute Reels in January 2025, and one guide says Reels over 3 minutes are not pushed for reach.
findings.note: Sources conflict, and none links an official 20-minute announcement (see also https://creatorflow.so/blog/how-long-can-instagram-reels-be/). Not a constraint for 45-90 s reels.

findings.claim: Meta's safe zone for Reels ads keeps about 14% at the top, 35% at the bottom and 6% on each side free of text and logos. On 1080x1920 that is 269 px top, 672 px bottom and 65 px per side, leaving a safe box of x 65-1015, y 269-1248. Meta publishes this for ads only, not for organic Reels; ads with disclaimers reportedly need the bottom 40% clear.
findings.note: Same figures appear in several third-party guides (e.g. https://www.hopperhq.com/blog/instagram-reel-size/); Meta's own Ads Guide was not retrieved. Pixel values are my calculation.

findings.claim: In November 2025 Instagram for iOS added full Dolby Vision HDR support (it previously stripped that metadata), and in May 2026 Android got Ultra HDR and a better capture-to-upload quality pipeline. No official confirmation of 4K Reels playback was found.

findings.claim: Local test with ffmpeg 6.1.1 on 2026-11-12. The chain was narration plus music bed, sidechain ducking (attack 15 ms, release 400 ms), then two-pass loudnorm (I=-14, TP=-1, LRA=11, linear). Final master: -14.0 LUFS integrated, 3.7 LU loudness range, -3.8 dBFS true peak. With the voice at -17.3 LUFS and the raw bed at -20.6 LUFS, the bed sat 12.1 dB under the voice at threshold 0.05 / ratio 6, 16.4 dB at 0.03 / 8, and 20.0 dB at 0.02 / 10. It recovered fully (-20.6 LUFS) in a 4 s gap.
findings.note: Synthetic stand-in voice (flite) and bed. Ducking depth depends on the voice level reaching the sidechain, so normalize the voice stem before ducking.

findings.claim: ffmpeg 6.1 behaviour relevant to this pipeline: atempo changes tempo over 0.5-100x; rubberband changes tempo and can preserve formants; loudnorm defaults to broadcast values (I=-24, TP=-2, LRA=7), so social targets must be set explicitly; libass (the ass and subtitles filters), sidechaincompress, xfade and drawtext are all built in.

Caption layout test: per-word libass events rendered correctly and sit inside the 269-1248 px safe band. The settings were Inter Black at 84 px with a 7 px outline, the active word in yellow #FFD700 at 108% scale, and the caption at y=1110 on 1080x1920, plus a 150 px number card at y=820.

findings.claim: The reference's arithmetic holds. 2^128 = 340,282,366,920,938,463,463,374,607,431,768,211,456 (39 digits). At 10^18 guesses per second, trying every key takes about 1.08 x 10^13 years, about 781 times a 13.8-billion-year universe, or about 391 times for the average (halfway) case.
findings.note: Worth knowing because this format lives on numbers that survive a fact-check.
